description.value: Circle K is a 24/7 convenience store and petrol station chain with a location in Surrey's Guildford area. This location offers snacks, beverages, fresh food options, coffee, and a roller grill for hot food. Public restrooms are available on-site, and the round-the-clock hours make it a practical resupply stop for cyclists at any point in their ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Circle K store page confirms the Surrey address (10020-152ND STREET, SURREY, V3R 8X8) and provides a phone number (+16045882663) not listed in OSM. The services section of the store page explicitly lists Fresh Food Fast, Roller Grill, Coffee, and Public Restrooms, providing positive evidence for hot food and washrooms. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, bike racks, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in the website content.
